notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
The main bug being fixed here is one with the fish radar. The value to tell the game what area you're in wasn't resetting when returning to the village which meant if the fish you were looking for was in the last area you were in before returning to town, the fish radar would tell you the fish was in the village.

Otherwise this is all minor visual error fixes.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.content:
-Fixed a game breaking glitch (thankfully no one discovered) which hardlocks you in the beginning of the game under certain circumstances.
-changed the initial cod fishing quest to require 3 instead of 5 cod
-changed the tutorial encounter with vermundus to be shorter after completing the tutorial
-Ally now gives you a free net when starting the Toniscine quest for the first time to encourage new players to use them
-fixed some minor glitches
